prompt:
Create a faithful illustrated 2D fighting game full-body sprite atlas of THE FEAR from ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 3 Snake Eater (2004), original PS2 model, NOT Delta or HD reinterpretation. Exact original identity and outfit from reference original-promo-0044 and PS2 intro: tall wiry muscular pale adult man, severe angular clean-shaven face, short black slicked-back hair with conspicuous WHITE streaks at BOTH temples, pronounced widow peak, no long ponytail. LONG-SLEEVED military fatigues matching the source: brown-olive khaki base covered by dark charcoal-black irregular tiger camouflage stripes, pointed open collar, same camo trousers. FULL dark black-blue gloves and dark lace-up combat boots. Never bare chest or bare arms, no torn shirt, no gold armor. BLACK shoulder webbing/chest harness with tall central vertical ribbed rectangular BLACK chest quiver/pouch block and small silver buckles, not an armored plate carrier. Olive khaki rectangular pouch at ANATOMICAL RIGHT front hip, smaller rear/belt fittings, dark belt, long narrow slack black webbing strap ends near legs. Anatomical RIGHT hip pouch must remain RIGHT on both independently drawn views. Outfit from original reference, not Naked Snake's rolled sleeves, not The Sorrow sweater, not remake.

The reference compact crossbow is LITTLE JOE: matte black small pistol-grip crossbow held in anatomical RIGHT hand, thin exposed straight central bolt rail, SHORT squared paired bow limbs connected in a triangular/trapezoid braced frame, thin taut black string across ends. No rifle barrel, magazine, optic, laser, gun stock, arrow quiver on back, fantasy large bow or firearm. Preserve exact depicted original mechanical silhouette; compact rail length about one forearm. No loaded loose flying arrow, no muzzle flash, no supernatural aura. Crossbow stays attached to gripping hand.

Make exactly TWELVE isolated complete figures of the SAME character, 4 columns x 3 rows equal INVISIBLE cells, row-major. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha PNG, WIDE landscape atlas. Generous transparent gutters at least 25 native pixels around each full figure, weapons, fingers, boot, strap and hair and at outer edges; 12 clearly separate alpha components. No text, labels, numbers, visible grid, background, ground shadow, trees, other people or detached props. Consistent upright source body scale in all cells; crouch and air tuck must remain physically smaller, never enlarge low postures. Detailed painted style, controlled dark contour, restrained realistic original palette, orthographic side view with modest three-quarter torso to see original gear. ALL 12 directly FACE SCREEN LEFT; head/nose, feet and movement LEFT. Each view is drawn independently; do not mirror source or swap anatomical hands or equipment sides.

POSE ORDER exactly: 0 idle ready stance, Little Joe in RIGHT hand lowered close hip, LEFT hand open guard; 1 second idle subtle breathing/shoulder shift same held bow; 2 walk contact A LEFT boot clearly forward and RIGHT boot trails, bow held low; 3 walk passing A left supports while right knee passes forward; 4 walk contact B RIGHT boot clearly forward, LEFT boot trails (opposite contact); 5 walk passing B right supports and left knee passes; 6 high guard LEFT forearm protects face and RIGHT-held compact bow angled down close torso; 7 second guard leaned back, LEFT forearm shields brow, RIGHT held bow close hip; 8 crouch guard low knees bent both feet planted and left palm ready, right bow close torso; 9 deeper compact crouch spine bent, tiny body compared to upright, bow retained; 10 spider-like acrobatic jump takeoff both knees tucked, FULL body airborne, bow gripped in right hand; 11 jump descent one boot extending to land, bow still gripped. No muzzle flashes or emitted bolts, no opponent, no invisible body or translucent fading in this locomotion atlas. EVERY one of the 12 faces SCREEN LEFT.
